text:
Sasha: quick q — where's the best Grafana/dashboard or quick queries to correlate per-model SM% + GPU memory + KV cache hitrate against batch_size? Seeing a throughput regression on canary: p95 up, SM% down. want a single view to triage.

Dmitri: try this dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rlGpuCorr/throughput-correlation — it has model-filter, sm%, mem usage, kv_hitrate, and recent batch_size panel. set grouping to "model" and time range to 30m-2h.

Sasha: thanks — can't find the panel that overlays batch_size. which panel is that?

Dmitri: panel id 7 (bottom-left). if you don't see overlay, toggle "show series as bar" in panel settings. also check traces for slow tokens: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace?span=canary_xyz

infra-bot: automated: canary run 2024-10-12T14:03Z recorded higher kv_evictions (0.018 -> 0.045) and GPU SM drop. Trace link: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/canary_xyz (owner: eng-runtime)

Ethan: quick PromQL snippets that helped me correlate:
```
# per-model SM% (5m):
(sum by (model) (rate(gpu_sm_active_tokens_total[5m]))) /
(sum by (model) (gpu_sm_capacity_tokens)) * 100

# kv cache hitrate (5m):
sum by (model) (rate(kvcache_hits_total[5m])) / sum by (model) (rate(kvcache_requests_total[5m])) * 100

# avg batch size per model:
avg by (model) (rate(request_tokens_total[5m]) / rate(request_count_total[5m]))
```

Ethan: if you overlay those three you usually see whether low SM% maps to big changes in avg batch size or kv hitrate.

Carla: for alerts: current SM% alert is noisy during autoscaler adjustments. proposal: only fire SM% < 55% for 10m AND kv_eviction_rate > 0.03 (5m) to reduce false positives. also add a runbook link.

Sasha: that would help. who owns alert tuning for canary?

Ben: I'll take ownership for the alert PR. i'll open a tiny RFC in #eng-runtime-alerts and add the suggested thresholds. will also add a short grafana link to the canary runbook. assigning to me now.

Sasha: great, thanks @Ben. any quick checks I should run now while ticket's open?

Dmitri: run the overlay in Grafana, grab one slow trace id, then run this quick k/v check in logs: `kubectl logs -n inference canary-xxx | grep -E \"evict|kvcache\" --context=3` — that'll show eviction bursts.

Ben: opened ticket RW-2982 with links and proposed alert rule. I'll post the PR link once it's up.

Sasha: perfect. dropping the dashboard link in the canary runbook after Ben's PR merges. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
